Frequently Asked Pricing Questions

How fast do I get my redesigned screens and code?+

For Pay Per Screen, typical turnaround is 3 to 5 business days. On our monthly studio retainer, we deliver updates every 48 to 72 hours until the entire application is completely transformed.

What formats do you deliver?+

Every delivery includes pixel-perfect Figma source files with organized design tokens, plus a live interactive Claude-coded prototype or production-ready Astro/Next.js/React components ready to merge.

Can I pause or cancel my subscription?+

Yes! Billing cycles are 31 days. If you only have two weeks of work, use your subscription for 14 days, pause it, and resume whenever your next sprint is ready.

How do you handle complex backend AI integrations?+

We specialize in deterministic LLM orchestration. We build using Python, FastAPI, LangChain/LangGraph, Pinecone, and Anthropic Claude APIs with full evaluation suites, error fallbacks, and sub-second caching.
